links.outcome: Readability of AI patient responses (Flesch–Szigriszt Index, INFLESZ category)
links.effect: Mean FSI 67.7 vs 53.9 in earlier data, a shift from 'somewhat difficult' to 'fairly easy'. Readability had minimal correlation with expert-rated quality.
links.quote: In contrast, readability showed a substantial increase (mean FSI 67.7 vs 53.9), corresponding to a shift from “somewhat difficult” to “fairly easy” patient comprehension.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the informational quality and readability of LLM-generated answers to patient ophthalmic questions using expert evaluation, but does not test a specific operational deployment practice or guardrail.
